questions.stemHtml: A 50-year-old woman comes to the out-patient with complaints of diminished vision along with floaters and flashes. The ophthalmologist uses the following instrument to assess the retinal lesions. Which of the following statements is true regarding the ophthalmoscopy done using the instrument shown in the image below?

options.label: A
options.text: Area of field in focus is 2 disc diameters.

options.label: B
options.text: The image produced is real and inverted.
